tools.name: search_worksheets
tools.description: Finds Sigma Prep math worksheet topics (Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, Geometry, Algebra 2, Precalculus, Calculus, Statistics) that match a request in plain words. Returns each topic's id, the difficulty levels it offers, its question types and its page on sigmaprep.io.

tools.name: create_worksheet
tools.description: Makes a new printable math worksheet for one topic as a PDF, with a separate copy that includes the answer key. Every call gives a fresh version of the problems. Topics are identified by the topic ids that the topic search returns.
